title: Weapon property
description: One entry from the weapon-property glossary: the rules a weapon obeys because its table row names this property. Weapon and armour properties are two content types rather than one because four names — interlocking, silent, strength and versatile — are published in both glossaries with different rules, and merging them would mean showing a reader the armour rule for a property their blaster has.

key.description: Stable slug identifying this property. It is the property's name lower-cased, which is also the leading word of the clause an equipment row writes — "burst 2" is the burst property with an argument of 2 — so a consumer can resolve a printed clause to this document by taking its leading words.

name.description: Display name in title case, as printed at the head of the glossary entry.

contentSet.description: Whether this property belongs to the core rules or to the community expanded-content supplement. Every archived weapon property is core.

description.description: Markdown giving the property's rules. The archived text opens with a level-four heading repeating the property's name; that heading is dropped on import, because the name is already the document's own name and a page that prints it twice reads as a mistake.
